articles.title: Macron faces highest-stakes budget showdown of his presidency
articles.summary: France's adoption of its 2026 national budget on February 2nd highlighted significant internal challenges. The process exposed a weakened presidency and a deeply fractured parliament, struggling to govern effectively. Moreover, France's substantial public debt is under close scrutiny from Brussels, indicating potential economic pressures and political instability within the European Union, impacting its standing on the international stage.

articles.title: Video Game History Foundation Says Piracy Remains the Only Viable Preservation Method
articles.summary: Frank Cifaldi, founder of the Video Game History Foundation, recently argued that digital piracy serves as the sole effective means for video game preservation. He critically highlighted game companies' shortcomings in safeguarding their own historical titles, thus placing the onus on piracy to prevent valuable gaming history from being lost forever, attributing the blame to their inaction.

articles.title: PM Modi launches Modified UDAN scheme; inaugurates terminal building of Jodhpur Airport
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Modified UDAN Scheme, allocating Rs 28,840 crore over ten years. This initiative aims to strengthen regional air connectivity and make air travel affordable for the common Indian citizen, embodying the 'Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik' vision. It focuses on expanding domestic aviation infrastructure and accessibility nationwide.

articles.title: Video Game History Foundation Says Piracy Remains the Only Preservation Method
articles.summary: Frank Cifaldi, founder of the Video Game History Foundation, asserts that piracy is the only effective way to preserve video games. He squarely blames game companies for inadequate digital archiving. This controversial claim highlights challenges in digital cultural heritage preservation and intellectual property, sparking debate on corporate responsibility versus community efforts in safeguarding digital history for future generations.
